CPU_CEILING.enforcement: RLIMIT_CPU soft 9000 / hard 10800 set by the supervisor before arithmetic; the executor's SIGXCPU handler (soft limit) seals VOID_RECORD_SEALED (cost) before the hard limit; the supervisor's wall watchdog does the same; the prelaunch verifier refuses if the authorization's ceilings differ

PRECISION_POLICY.justification: the R1 real front-end refuses any precision other than 256; R1 and R2 precision studies classify the producer as STAGNATING (width floors are mathematical: truncation, residual and resolvent terms, not rounding); the R4 certificates are frozen at 256. Escalation cannot convert INCONCLUSIVE and would only add exposure.
PRECISION_POLICY.rule: one frozen rung. Execute at 256; the result at 256 is final for this protocol whatever its verdict.

activation_rule: Activation copies this template to protocol/AUTHORIZATION_ACTIVE.json (a regular file, not a symlink) changing ONLY the activation fields (EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED, PROTOCOL_FREEZE_COMMIT, PRODUCER_R4_IDENTITY.executor_binding_sha256, AUTHORIZED_BY, AUTHORIZATION_UTC), committed once and pushed strictly after the amendment commit, and only after a separate explicit user authorization message. This template is never edited.
